mapper.update: INSERT INTO public.entity_attribute_stage_values (game_id, entity_id, attr_key, stage, value, change_revision, updated_at) VALUES (#{gameId}, #{entityId}, #{attrKey}, #{stage}, #{value}, #{changeRevision}, NOW()) ON CONFLICT (game_id, entity_id, attr_key, stage) DO UPDATE SET value = EXCLUDED.value, change_revision = EXCLUDED.change_revision, updated_at = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT game_id AS "gameId", entity_id AS "entityId", attr_key AS "attrKey", stage AS stage, value AS value, change_revision AS "changeRevision", updated_at AS "updatedAt" FROM public.entity_attribute_stage_values WHERE game_id = #{gameId} AND change_revision > #{previousRevision} AND change_revision <= #{publishRevision} ORDER BY change_revision, entity_id, attr_key, stage
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.entity_attribute_stage_values_log ( game_id, version_id, change_revision, entity_id, attr_key, stage, value ) SELECT game_id, #{versionId}, change_revision, entity_id, attr_key, stage, value FROM public.entity_attribute_stage_values WHERE game_id = #{gameId} AND change_revision > #{previousRevision} AND change_revision <= #{publishRevision} ON CONFLICT (game_id, entity_id, attr_key, stage, version_id) DO UPDATE SET change_revision = EXCLUDED.change_revision, value = EXCLUDED.value
